name: Jorhat

description.title: Jorhat – The Cultural Heart of Assam
description.short: Known as the cultural capital of Assam, famous for tea gardens, heritage sites, and vibrant festivals.
description.long: Jorhat, often called the cultural capital of Assam, is known for its tea gardens, heritage sites, and vibrant festivals. Surrounded by lush plantations, it offers visitors a glimpse into Assam's tea culture. With historic satras nearby and Majuli within reach, Jorhat combines tradition, nature, and hospitality in equal measure.
description.history: Jorhat was the last capital of the Ahom Kingdom and is known for its rich cultural heritage. It's a major center for tea production and Assamese culture.
description.overview: A charming city where tea culture meets traditional heritage, offering authentic experiences of Assam's cultural richness.

safetyInformation: Be respectful when visiting tea gardens and satras.
Stay on designated paths in heritage areas.
travelTips: Visit during Bihu festival for cultural experiences.
Take a tea garden tour to learn about tea production.
Explore nearby satras for spiritual insights.
